# Lisbon Remote-Worker Apartment Fit

You want a **1-bedroom apartment in Lisbon for June 2026** with a **€1,600 max budget**, **50+ sqm**, **reliable internet**, and space for a desk. Based on those priorities, **Option A is the best overall fit**, with **Option C** as the strongest alternative if you value space and a calmer setting more than location.

## Ranked Apartment Comparison

| Option | Rent | Size | Area | Internet | Noise | Fit for Your Needs |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| A | €1,450 | 54 sqm | City center | 300 Mbps | Noisy street | **Best balance**: meets all hard requirements, central, good speed |
| B | €1,300 | 48 sqm | Suburban | 500 Mbps | Quiet | Fails size minimum; otherwise strong for work-from-home |
| C | €1,580 | 61 sqm | Near park | 200 Mbps | Moderate noise | Meets all requirements; best space, but tight on budget and slower internet |
| D | €1,200 | 52 sqm | Farther out | 100 Mbps | Quiet | Meets minimums, but weakest internet and less convenient location |

## Best Fit and Trade-offs

### Option A: Best overall for a remote worker
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

- **Why it wins:** It satisfies every hard requirement with a comfortable margin on size and strong internet.
- **Workspace value:** 54 sqm is enough to carve out a desk area without making the apartment feel cramped.
- **Main trade-off:** The **noisy street** and city-center setting may affect calls, focus, and sleep unless the windows are well insulated.

### Option C: Best if space and atmosphere matter most
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg

- **Why it’s compelling:** At **61 sqm**, it gives you the most room for a dedicated office setup and daily comfort.
- **Main trade-off:** It is **closest to the budget ceiling** and has only **200 Mbps**, which is still usable but less ideal than A for heavy video calls or large uploads.
- **Best for:** Someone who wants a better living experience and can accept a bit less internet speed.

### Option D: Lowest cost, but weakest work setup
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

- **Pros:** Cheapest option, quiet, and meets the size minimum.
- **Cons:** **100 Mbps** is the weakest connection here, and being farther out can add commute friction and reduce convenience.
- **Best for:** Budget-first renters who do not need frequent high-bandwidth work.

### Option B: Strong internet, but too small
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/wifi.svg

- **Pros:** Quiet and very fast internet at **500 Mbps**.
- **Deal-breaker:** **48 sqm misses your 50 sqm minimum**, so it does not fully meet your stated needs.
- **Best for:** Only if you are willing to relax the size requirement.

## Recommendation

**Choose Option A** if you want the safest all-around match for a remote-work move to Lisbon.

- It meets **budget, size, internet, and 1-bedroom** requirements.
- It offers the best balance of **location convenience** and **work performance**.
- The only notable downside is **street noise**, which is a manageable trade-off if you use noise-canceling headphones or confirm good window insulation.

**Choose Option C instead** if you prioritize **more living space and a better environment** over being in the center, and you can live with a tighter budget margin plus slower internet.
